# `Q-21-2` — Typst Version Too Old

> The `typst` binary found on `PATH` reports a version older than the
> minimum this Quarto version requires.

## What this means

Quarto found a `typst` binary, but its reported version is below the
minimum Quarto's typst support requires (currently `0.8`).

## Why this happens

- The `typst` on `PATH` (or pointed at by `QUARTO_TYPST`) is an older
  release, predating a feature or fix Quarto's vendored template/filters
  depend on.

## How to fix

Upgrade typst to a version at least as new as the minimum required —
see [typst.app](https://typst.app) for install/upgrade instructions.

## Related errors

- [`Q-21-1`](Q-21-1.qmd) — typst could not be found at all.
